enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Force Blast 4: This weapon ripples with intense force, dealing 4d6 Force damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Force damage on a critical hit.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Blunt Trauma: This weapon is incredibly dense and delivers especially powerful blows. When rolling a 19 or 20 on an attack with this weapon, your critical multiplier is increased by +1.
Construct Bane 4: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt creations, dealing an additional 4d10 bane damage vs. Constructs.

Remodeling Renegade: 3 Pieces Equipped:+10% Artifact Bonus to Fortification Bypass+5% Artifact Bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot+10 Artifact Bonus to Physical Resistance Rating4 Pieces Equipped:+5 Artifact Bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+5% Artifact Bonus to Damage vs. Helpless opponents
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
